name: Krakow people Panel on climate change
content: Problems and PurposeThe aim of Kraków Citizens’ Assembly on Climate is to answer the question, how can the City and its residents reduce energy consumption and increase the use of renewable energy?Background History and ContextThis process was born out of the idea that it is crucial to have a long-term vision for reducing greenhouse gas emissions in order to be convinced that our actions are aimed at making a greater impact on the climate situation.Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Participant Recruitment and Selection20,000 citizens were sent a letter of invitation, there was an invitation to participate in the panel. Interested people can register, and 60 panellists was selected from among all candidates.Methods and Tools Used What Went On: Process, Interaction, and ParticipationAs part of this assembly, all interested residents could listen to presentations about climate transformation, citizen engagement, buildings, and the energy sector. Speeches were delivered by specialists,Influence, Outcomes, and EffectsAfter the end of Krakowski Panel Klimatyczny, the city will receive a report that will help it in its climate transformation.Analysis and Lessons Learned See Also References External Links https://www.climate-kic.org/news/krakow-transforming-the-city-towards-climate-neutrality/#:~:text=We%20have%20just%20launched%20Krakow,into%20account%20the%20common%20good.
